system.description: Touch the victim, spend a Blood Trait, and defeat her in a challenge of your Mental Traits against her Physical Traits to age her decades in a moment. She gains the Negative Traits Decrepit, Sickly, and her choice of Delicate, Dull, Forgetful, or Oblivious until the next dusk or dawn. A mortal victim risks cardiac arrest each turn of strenuous activity, requiring a Static Physical Challenge against a five-Trait difficulty.
